name: Saint Ursula
contribution: A Romano-British virgin and martyr possibly of royal origin.

checks.lead: Ursula (Latin for 'little she-bear') was a Romano-British virgin and martyr possibly of royal origin. She is venerated as a saint in the Catholic Church, Eastern Orthodox Church and the Anglican Communion. Her feast day in the pre-1970 General Roman Calendar and in some regional calendars of the ordinary form of the Roman Rite is 21 October.
checks.photo: no death year in or after 1860
